Overview

Salto is a city in SA with a population of 120,000. A northwestern city on the Uruguay River, known for its hot springs and citrus production. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
